title: Microservices Architecture
intro: Microservices interviews are the broadest backend topic — the module has the most topics because the surface is huge. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with fundamentals (what microservices are, why, the trade-offs), then service design (decomposition by business capability). The communication tier follows — API gateway, service discovery, load balancing, the patterns that make services find and talk to each other. Resilience (circuit breaker, saga) is the production tier, then observability (distributed tracing) and verification (contract testing). Feign, migration strategies, and service mesh close out the advanced tier. It closes with comparisons and scenario-based questions.
